about_attribution: Vizulla is built on the open-source Chromium project (Blink and V8).
agent_goal_placeholder: Book a table for 2 on restaurant-x.rw, Friday 7 PM
agent_grant_for: Use my signed-in session on {origin} for {minutes} minutes
agent_hint_stage_a: Runs in an isolated session (no cookies or logins), stays on the sites you approve, and never submits or pays.
agent_hint_stage_b: Runs on the sites you approve. Personal data and anything that submits or pays needs your confirmation first.
agent_injection_body: This page contains text that looks like instructions to the agent: “{excerpt}”. The agent will still only do what your plan allows.
agent_isolated_note: Isolated session: the agent can't see your cookies, logins, or other tabs.
agent_log_clear_confirm: Delete the whole agent action log?
agent_log_desc: Everything the agent observed, every action it proposed, what the browser decided, and what you confirmed. Kept 30 days.
agent_new_origin_body: This site isn't in the plan you approved. The agent can continue only if you allow it.
agent_not_confirmed: Stopped: you didn't confirm the action.
agent_off_ai: Turn on AI in Settings to use the agent.
agent_off_flag: The task agent is an experiment. Turn it on in vizulla://flags.
agent_off_optin: Join the agent test program in Settings → Task agent.
agent_off_stale: The agent is off because this build is out of date. Update Vizulla to use it.
agent_profile_note: Encrypted on this device. The agent's model never sees these values: it uses placeholders, and Vizulla fills them in after you confirm.
agent_profile_title: Personal data for the agent (Stage B)
agent_refused_origin: Stopped: you didn't allow a new site.
agent_rejected: Stopped: the browser blocked an action outside your plan ({reason}).
agent_sign_in_yourself: This page asks for a sign-in. The agent never handles passwords: sign in yourself, then resume.
agent_values_label: Values the agent may type (it refers to them by handle, never sees anything else of yours)
agent_you_have_control: You have control. Resume when you're done.
ai_composer_hint: Answers use only this page. Enter to send.
ai_disclosure_declined: Not sent. Nothing left your device.
ai_empty_body: Summarize it, or ask anything about it. Every answer links to the passage it came from.
ai_err_auth: The provider rejected the API key. Check it in Settings.
ai_err_empty_page: There's no readable text on this page.
ai_err_internal_page: The assistant doesn't read Vizulla's own pages. Open a website or PDF.
ai_err_network: Couldn't reach the AI provider. Check your connection.
ai_err_no_key: Add your {provider} API key in Settings → AI.
ai_err_quota: You've reached today's free limit. Try again tomorrow or use your own key.
ai_err_refused: This page looks sensitive and no on-device model is available, so nothing was sent.
ai_err_scanned_pdf: This PDF is a scanned image with no text layer. Text recognition (OCR) isn't available yet.
ai_mode_byo_desc: Use Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, or a local OpenAI-compatible server with your key.
ai_mode_cloud_desc: Through the Vizulla Gateway. No account needed. Prompts are never stored.
ai_mode_local_desc: Runs on this computer. Nothing leaves your device.
ai_mode_off_desc: No AI features run at all.
ai_off_panel: AI is off. Turn it on in Settings to summarize and ask about pages.
ai_partially_sourced: Partially sourced: check the cited passages
archive_desc: Tabs you haven't used for a while are archived here and kept for {days} days.
bookmarks_empty: No bookmarks yet. Press Ctrl/⌘+D on a page to add one.
cb_placeholder_long: Search, enter an address, or type > for commands
cb_tab_search_placeholder: Find a tab, including archived ones…
clear_data_confirm: Clear history, cookies, and cached files? You'll be signed out of most sites.
clear_history_body: This deletes your browsing history on this device. Spaces, pins, and bookmarks stay.
disclosure_body: To answer, Vizulla will send about {kb} KB of text from {sites} to {provider}.
disclosure_point_local: You can switch to on-device AI anytime in Settings.
disclosure_point_retention: The Vizulla Gateway doesn't store prompts or answers. BYO providers follow their own policies.
disclosure_point_what: Only the readable text of the current page and your question are sent: no cookies, passwords, or other tabs.
disclosure_remember: Don't ask again for this site
err_cert: The site's security certificate isn't valid, so Vizulla stopped the connection to protect your data.
flags_warning: These features are experimental. Changing them may make Vizulla unstable.
group_ai_none: No obvious groups among these tabs
import_done: Imported {bookmarks} bookmarks and {history} history entries from {name}.
import_extensions_hint: Extensions aren't copied. Install them again from the Chrome Web Store.
import_none: No other browsers found on this computer.
import_passwords_delete_csv: Delete the CSV file now: it contains your passwords in plain text.
import_passwords_hint: Passwords: export a CSV from your old browser, then import it under Passwords.
memory_cant_save: This page can't be saved to Memory (private, sensitive, or excluded).
memory_empty_off: Memory is off. Turn it on to find pages later by what they said.
memory_empty_on: Nothing remembered yet. Pages are indexed while your computer is idle.
memory_search: Search what you've seen: “the laptop review from yesterday”
memory_wipe_confirm: Erase everything in Memory? This can't be undone.
nl_confirm_body: You asked in your own words. Vizulla matched it to this command, which changes your data.
notes_empty: No notes yet. Select text on a page and choose “Clip to Notes”.
ntp_search: Search with {engine} or enter an address
ob_ai_body: You choose where your data goes. You can change this anytime.
ob_done_body: Press Ctrl/⌘+K anytime to search, open tabs, or run commands. Spaces keep work and life apart.
ob_import_body: Import bookmarks and history from another browser. Nothing is uploaded.
ob_layout_body: Vertical tabs give long titles room. You can switch anytime.
ob_layout_horizontal: Tabs along the top, like a classic browser.
ob_layout_vertical: Tabs, pins, and Spaces in a sidebar.
ob_welcome_body: A calm, private browser with an assistant that reads pages with you and shows its sources.
perm_clipboard_read: See text and images in your clipboard
perm_idle_detection: Know when you're using this device
perm_openExternal: Open an app on your computer
privacy_ai_off: AI is off. Nothing has been sent.
privacy_ai_sub: Every request: which site, how much text, and where it was processed. Kept {days} days. Content is never logged.
privacy_nothing_yet: Nothing blocked yet. Browse a little and check back.
privacy_top_sites: Sites with the most blocked items
pw_breached: {count} of your passwords appeared in a data breach. Change them.
pw_csv_help: Chrome: Settings → Passwords → Export. Firefox: Passwords → ⋯ → Export. Only a 5-character hash prefix leaves your device during a breach check.
pw_desc: Encrypted on this device with a key held by your system keychain.
pw_no_breaches: None of your passwords were found in known breaches.
reader_expired: This reader view has expired. Go back and open it again.
security_insecure: Not secure: information you send could be read by others
set_3p_cookies_desc: Stops sites you don't visit from tracking you across sites.
set_accent_desc: Spaces use their own color when you're in them.
set_agent_grant_desc: How long the agent may use your signed-in session for one site (Stage B).
set_agent_tester: Join the task agent test program
set_agent_tester_desc: The agent is experimental. It runs in an isolated session and asks before anything sensitive.
set_ai_disclosures: Sites you allowed to use cloud AI
set_ai_disclosures_none: None yet. You'll be asked the first time per site.
set_ai_save_desc: Off: conversations disappear when you close the tab.
set_archive_desc: Unpinned tabs you haven't opened for a while move to the archive. Undo anytime.
set_classic_desc: Tabs on top, a classic address bar and bookmarks bar, assistant hidden.
set_clear_data_desc: History, cookies and site data, cached files.
set_compat_url_desc: For Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, or another local server. Requests to localhost count as on-device.
set_cookie_banners_desc: Automatically declines non-essential cookies where possible.
set_crash_desc: Off by default. Reports contain no URLs or page content.
set_doh_desc: Encrypts the lookup of site addresses (DNS over HTTPS).
set_downloads_ask: Ask where to save each file
set_fingerprinting_desc: Adds small random noise to canvas, audio, and WebGL readouts so sites can't identify you.
set_gateway_desc: The Vizulla AI Gateway. Change only for testing or a regional deployment.
set_https_first_desc: Upgrades connections to HTTPS and falls back only if the site doesn't support it.
set_keys_note: Keys are stored encrypted with {where}. They never reach web pages or the assistant panel.
set_layout_desc: Vertical tabs in a sidebar, or tabs on top.
set_memory_battery_desc: By default, pages are indexed only when plugged in and idle.
set_memory_desc: Remember pages you visit so you can find them later by what they said. Encrypted, on this device only.
set_memory_saver_desc: Background tabs release memory and reload when you open them. 0 = never.
set_restore_desc: Reopen your Spaces and tabs where you left off.
set_search_engine_desc: Used for searches in the Command Bar.
set_shields_desc: Blocks ads and trackers on every site.
set_telemetry_desc: Off by default. Aggregated counts only, never URLs or content.
shields_breakage_hint: If the site looks broken, turn Shields off for it.
shields_off_for_site: Shields are off for this site
shields_on_for_site: Shields are on for this site
space_delete_body: Its tabs move to the archive of another Space, so you can still get them back.
sync_code_desc: Enter this code on your other device. Anyone with it can join, so keep it private. Without it your data can't be recovered.
sync_desc: End-to-end encrypted. The server only ever sees ciphertext.
sync_e2ee_note: Encrypted on this device with a key derived from your sync code.
sync_enter_code: Enter the sync code from your other device
sync_unavailable: Sync isn't available in this build.
toast_focus: Focus on: {count} tabs in other Spaces are asleep
toast_split_needs_tab: Open another tab to use split view
upd_manual: Update downloaded. Open it to finish installing.
settings_updates_auto_desc: Asks GitHub for new releases at startup and every few hours. Nothing about you is sent.
set_custom_engine_desc: Any site: paste its search address with %s where the words go.
set_custom_engine_invalid: Use an https:// address that contains %s exactly once.
pm_empty_body: Vizulla offers to save your password when you sign in to a site.
pm_compromised_desc: Found in a data breach. Change these first.
pm_reused_desc: Used on more than one site.
pm_offer_save_desc: Ask after you sign in to a site. Never in private windows.
pm_export_desc: A CSV file other password managers can read. Anyone with the file can see your passwords.
pm_never_saved_none: Sites you choose “Never” for appear here.
profile_subtitle: Each profile keeps its own tabs, history, passwords and settings.
profile_delete_confirm: Delete {name} and all its data on this device?
ext_subtitle: Add features to Vizulla. Extensions from the Chrome Web Store work here.
ext_get_body: Browse the Chrome Web Store, then choose “Add to Chrome” on any extension.
ext_paste_label: Chrome Web Store link or extension ID
ext_paste_invalid: That isn't a Chrome Web Store link or extension ID.
ext_empty_body: Extensions add tools like dark mode, password managers and grammar checks.
ext_no_permissions: This extension needs no special permissions.
ext_private_note: Extensions don't run in private windows.
ext_compat_note: Most Chrome extensions work. A few Chrome features, such as keyboard shortcuts for extensions, aren't available yet.
extperm_all_sites: Read and change all your data on all websites
extperm_sites: Read and change your data on {sites}
extperm_history: Read and change your browsing history
extperm_clipboardRead: Read data you copy and paste
extperm_clipboardWrite: Modify data you copy and paste
tm_lead: What each part of Vizulla is using right now. Updates every two seconds.
tm_hint: Ending a tab's process puts its tabs to sleep: they reload when you open them.
ads_allowed_everywhere: Ads are allowed on every site.
set_block_ads_desc: Vizulla is ad-free: ads and empty ad slots are removed. Turn off to see ads everywhere; trackers stay blocked.
set_ads_allowed_none: None. Allow ads on a site from the shield button in the toolbar.
set_shields_aggressive_desc: Also blocks known trackers that filter lists miss. A few sites may not work as expected.
set_restart_note: Takes effect after you restart Vizulla.
private_locked_body: Your private tabs are hidden while Vizulla was in the background.
set_private_capture_desc: Screenshots and screen recordings show private windows as blank. Applies to new private windows.
set_lock_private: Lock private windows in the background
set_lock_private_desc: When you switch away from Vizulla, private tabs are hidden until you unlock them with Touch ID.
ntp_private_lead: Other people who use this device won't see your activity. Downloads and bookmarks you save are kept.
ntp_private_visible: Your activity might still be visible to
ntp_private_v_sites: Websites you visit and sign in to
set_search_suggestions_desc: As you type in the address bar, your search engine suggests searches. Sent without cookies, and never from private windows.
tool_screenshot_saved: Screenshot saved to Downloads and copied
tool_qr_title: Scan to open on your phone
tools_page_only: Open a web page to use these tools.
set_mcp: Let AI coding tools use Vizulla (MCP)
set_mcp_desc: Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and other MCP tools can list and read your tabs, take screenshots, open pages and read console logs. Only on this computer, only with the token, and never in private windows.
set_mcp_clients_none: None yet. Vizulla asks the first time a tool connects.
mcp_approve_body: An AI coding tool on this computer wants to connect. It will be able to:
mcp_can_tabs: See the titles and addresses of your open tabs
mcp_can_read: Read pages and take screenshots of them, and read their console logs
perm_ask_clipboard_read: See text and images in your clipboard
perm_ask_window_management: Manage windows on all your displays
perm_ask_idle_detection: Know when you are actively using this device
perm_ask_local_fonts: Use the fonts on your computer
perm_ask_local_network: Find and connect to devices on your local network
perm_ask_open_external: Open an app on your computer
perm_ask_storage_access: Use cookies and data it saved on other sites
perm_ask_captured_surface_control: Scroll and zoom tabs you share
perm_ask_xr: Use your VR or AR device
perm_ask_background_sync: Finish sending and receiving data after you leave
set_perm_defaults_desc: What sites can do unless you choose otherwise for a site.
dev_none: No compatible devices found. Make sure the device is connected and turned on.
tech_scanning: Looking at how this site is built…
tech_none: No known technologies found. The site may hide them, or use custom code.
tech_note: Detected from this page's code, headers and cookies. Sites can hide or fake these clues.
set_clean_links_desc: Removes click-tracking tags (utm_, fbclid, gclid…) from links and skips redirect hops, before the page loads.
set_webrtc: Hide my IP address from WebRTC
set_webrtc_desc: Video-call features can’t reveal your local network address or the real IP behind a VPN.
set_gpc_desc: Tells every site not to sell or share your personal data. In many places, sites are legally required to honour it.
set_clear_on_exit: Clear cookies and site data on exit
set_clear_on_exit_desc: Signs you out everywhere and removes site storage and cache when Vizulla quits. History, passwords and extensions stay.
checkup_all: All {total} protections are on. You’re well protected.
checkup_blocked: {count} trackers and ads blocked in the last 30 days
set_fonts_desc: Websites always keep their own fonts. These are used only where a page doesn’t choose one.
set_font_min_desc: Text on websites is never drawn smaller than this. Applies to tabs you open next.
set_preload_desc: When you rest the pointer on a link to the site you’re on, it loads ahead of your click. Other sites are never contacted early, and private windows never preload.
